templates.pat: The Variant Annotation Integrator (VAI) is a research tool for associating annotations from the UCSC database with your uploaded set of variant calls. It uses gene annotations to predict functional effects of variants on transcripts. For example, a variant might be located in the coding sequence of one transcript, but in the intron of an alternatively spliced transcript of the same gene; the VAI will return the predicted functional effect for each transcript. The VAI can optionally add several other types of relevant information: the dbSNP identifier if the variant is found in {{1}}, protein damage scores for missense variants from the {{2}}, and conservation scores computed from multi-species alignments. The VAI can optionally filter results to retain only specific functional effect categories, variant properties and multi-species conservation status.
templates.zh: 变异注释整合器（VAI）是一种研究工具，用于把 UCSC 数据库中的注释与您上传的变异检出结果关联起来。它利用基因注释预测变异对转录本的功能效应。例如，一个变异可能位于某个转录本的编码序列中，却位于同一基因另一个可变剪接转录本的内含子中；VAI 会返回每个转录本的预测功能效应。VAI 还可以选择性加入其他几类相关信息：若变异见于 {{1}}，则给出 dbSNP 标识符；给出 {{2}} 中错义变异的蛋白质损伤评分；以及由多物种比对计算得到的保守性评分。VAI 还可以选择性筛选结果，只保留特定的功能效应类别、变异属性和多物种保守状态。

templates.pat: In order to use the VAI, you must provide variant calls in either the {{1}} or {{2}} format. pgSnp-formatted variants may be uploaded as a {{3}}. Compressed and indexed VCF files must be on a web server (HTTP, HTTPS or FTP) and configured as Custom Tracks, or if you happen to have a {{4}}, as hub tracks.

templates.pat: Currently, the VAI produces output comparable to Ensembl's {{1}}, in either tab-separated text format or HTML. Columns are described {{2}}. When text output is selected, entering an output file name causes output to be saved in a local file instead of appearing in the browser, optionally compressed by gzip (compression reduces file size and network traffic, which results in faster downloads). When HTML is selected, output always appears in the browser window and the output file name is ignored.

templates.pat: Anyone familiar with Ensembl's {{1}} will doubtless notice similarities in options and interface. In collaboration with our colleagues at Ensembl, we have made an effort to limit the differences between the tools by using Sequence Ontology terms to describe variants' functional effects and by creating a "VEP" output format. Any bugs in the VAI, however, are in the VAI only.
templates.zh: 熟悉 Ensembl {{1}} 的人无疑会注意到选项和界面上的相似之处。我们与 Ensembl 的同行合作，通过使用序列本体术语描述变异的功能效应并提供“VEP”输出格式，努力缩小两个工具之间的差异。不过 VAI 中的任何缺陷都只属于 VAI。

templates.pat: {{1}} uses sequence homology and the physical properties of amino acids to predict whether an amino acid substitution affects protein function. Scores less than 0.05 are classified as Damaging ("D" in output); higher scores are classified as Tolerated ("T"). ({{2}})

templates.pat: {{1}} applies a naive Bayes classifier using several sequence-based and structure-based predictive features including refined multi-species alignments. PolyPhen-2 was trained on two datasets, and dbNSFP provides scores for both. The HumDiv training set is intended for evaluating rare alleles potentially involved in complex phenotypes, for example in genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Predictions are derived from scores, with these ranges for HumDiv: "probably damaging" ("D") for scores in [0.957, 1]; "possibly damaging" ("P") for scores in [0.453, 0.956]; "benign" ("B") for scores in [0, 0.452]. HumVar is intended for studies of Mendelian diseases, for which mutations with drastic effects must be sorted out from abundant mildly deleterious variants. Predictions are derived from scores, with these ranges for HumDiv: "probably damaging" ("D") for scores in [0.909, 1]; "possibly damaging" ("P") for scores in [0.447, 0.908]; "benign" ("B") for scores in [0, 0.446]. ({{2}})
templates.zh: {{1}} 使用朴素贝叶斯分类器，采用多种基于序列和基于结构的预测特征，包括精细化的多物种比对。PolyPhen-2 在两个数据集上训练，dbNSFP 提供两者的评分。HumDiv 训练集用于评估可能与复杂表型相关的罕见等位基因，例如全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的情形。预测由评分导出，HumDiv 的分段为：评分在 [0.957, 1] 为“probably damaging”（“D”）；[0.453, 0.956] 为“possibly damaging”（“P”）；[0, 0.452] 为“benign”（“B”）。HumVar 用于孟德尔病研究，此类研究需要从大量轻度有害变异中挑出效应剧烈的突变。预测由评分导出，HumDiv 的分段为：评分在 [0.909, 1] 为“probably damaging”（“D”）；[0.447, 0.908] 为“possibly damaging”（“P”）；[0, 0.446] 为“benign”（“B”）。（{{2}}）

templates.pat: {{1}} applies a naive Bayes classifier trained on a large dataset (>390,000 known disease mutations from HGMD Professional and >6,800,000 presumably harmless SNP and Indel polymorphisms from the 1000 Genomes Project). Variants that cause a premature stop codon resulting in nonsense-mediated decay (NMD), as well as variants marked as probable-pathogenic or pathogenic in ClinVar, are automatically presumed to be disease-causing ("A"). Variants with all three genotypes present in HapMap or with at least 4 heterozygous genotypes in 1000 Genomes are automatically presumed to be harmless polymorphisms ("P"). Variants not automatically determined to be disease-causing or polymorphic are predicted to be "disease-causing" ("D") or polymorphisms ("N") by the classifier. Probability scores close to 1 indicate high "security" of the prediction; probabilities close to 0 for an automatic prediction ("A" or "P") can indicate that the classifier predicted a different outcome. ({{2}})
templates.zh: {{1}} 使用朴素贝叶斯分类器，训练数据量很大（>390,000 个来自 HGMD Professional 的已知致病突变，以及 >6,800,000 个来自千人基因组计划、推测无害的 SNP 和 Indel 多态性）。导致提前终止密码子并引发无义介导降解（NMD）的变异，以及在 ClinVar 中标注为 probable-pathogenic 或 pathogenic 的变异，会自动推定为致病（“A”）。在 HapMap 中三种基因型均出现，或在千人基因组中至少有 4 个杂合基因型的变异，会自动推定为无害多态性（“P”）。未被自动判定为致病或多态性的变异，由分类器预测为“disease-causing”（“D”）或多态性（“N”）。概率评分接近 1 表示预测的“把握”高；自动预测（“A”或“P”）的概率接近 0 可能说明分类器预测的是另一结果。（{{2}}）

templates.pat: {{1}} uses sequence homologs grouped into families and sub-families by combinatorial entropy formalism to compute a Functional Impact Score (FIS). It is intended for use in cancer studies, in which both gain of function and loss of function are important; the authors also identify a third category, "switch of function." A prediction of "high" or "medium" indicates that the variant probably has some functional impact, while "low" or "neutral" indicate that the variant is probably function-neutral. ({{2}})
templates.zh: {{1}} 利用按组合熵形式划分到科和亚科的序列同源物计算功能影响评分（FIS）。它面向癌症研究，这类研究中功能获得和功能丧失都很重要；作者还提出第三类“功能转换”。预测为“high”或“medium”表示该变异可能有一定功能影响，而“low”或“neutral”表示该变异可能对功能中性。（{{2}}）

templates.pat: {{1}} uses comparative genomics to identify variants that disrupt highly conserved amino acids. Variants are predicted to be deleterious ("D"), neutral ("N") or unknown ("U"). ({{2}})
templates.zh: {{1}} 利用比较基因组学找出破坏高度保守氨基酸的变异。变异被预测为有害（“D”）、中性（“N”）或未知（“U”）。（{{2}}）

templates.pat: {{1}} (available only for hg38/GRCh38) uses a classifier that was trained with ~45,000 disease mutations from HGMD and ~45,000 high frequency missense variants (putatively neutral) from the Exome Sequencing Project. ({{2}})
templates.zh: {{1}}（仅适用于 hg38/GRCh38）使用一个分类器，其训练数据为来自 HGMD 的约 45,000 个致病突变，以及来自外显子组测序计划的约 45,000 个高频错义变异（推测为中性）。（{{2}}）
